title: AI in Everyday Life
introduction: This lesson shows how artificial intelligence is already part of the things we do every day, from searching online to using our phones.

sections.heading: AI in Online Search
sections.subheading: How search engines use AI to find information quickly
paragraphs: Search engines like Google use AI to understand the words you type and to rank the most relevant pages.
The AI models look at many factors such as your location, recent trends, and the meaning of the query to give you fast results.

example.title: Finding a recipe with Google
example.content: You type "chocolate cake recipe" and Google’s AI suggests a list of popular recipes, showing pictures and cooking steps within seconds.

sections.heading: Recommendation Systems
sections.subheading: Personalized suggestions on videos, music, and shopping
paragraphs: Websites and apps analyze your past behavior with AI to recommend new items you might like.
These systems learn patterns from many users, so they can suggest movies, songs, or products that match your taste.

example.title: YouTube video suggestions
example.content: After watching a cooking video, YouTube’s AI shows more cooking videos and related recipes on your home page.

sections.heading: Smart Navigation and Maps
sections.subheading: AI helps plan routes and avoid traffic
paragraphs: Map apps use AI to predict traffic conditions and suggest the fastest route.
The AI continuously updates the route based on real‑time data from other drivers and road sensors.

example.title: Getting directions on Google Maps
example.content: You ask for directions to a grocery store, and the app shows a route that avoids a traffic jam, updating it if the jam clears.

sections.heading: AI in Smartphones and Cameras
sections.subheading: Voice assistants, photo enhancements, and predictive text
paragraphs: Your phone’s AI can understand spoken commands, improve photos, and suggest the next word while you type.
These features work by learning from large data sets and from your own usage patterns.

example.title: Using Siri to set a reminder
example.content: You say, "Hey Siri, remind me to call Mom at 5 PM," and Siri records the reminder using natural‑language processing.

sections.heading: AI in Banking and Shopping
sections.subheading: Automation and fraud detection in everyday transactions
paragraphs: Banks use AI to spot unusual activity and protect your account from fraud.
Online stores use AI to show you products similar to what you have bought before, making shopping faster.

example.title: Credit‑card fraud alert
example.content: Your bank’s AI detects a purchase in a different city and sends you an instant alert to confirm the transaction.

practice.title: Spot AI Around You
practice.instruction: Look around your home, phone, or computer and write down three things that use AI, such as a voice assistant, a recommendation list, or a navigation app.

keyTakeaways: AI is present in many everyday tools like search engines, maps, and smartphones.
Recommendation systems use AI to suggest videos, music, and products based on your behavior.
AI helps keep transactions safe and makes navigation faster by learning from real‑time data.

mcqs.question: Which factor is NOT mentioned as something AI in search engines considers when ranking results?
mcqs.explanation: The lesson lists location, recent trends, and query meaning, but does not mention weather as a factor.

mcqs.question: How does a recommendation system improve its suggestions over time?
options: By learning patterns from many users
By analyzing only your own past behavior
mcqs.explanation: The lesson explains that recommendation systems learn patterns from many users to suggest items that match your taste.

mcqs.question: What does a map app do when it receives real‑time traffic data from other drivers?
options: It updates the suggested route to avoid congestion
mcqs.explanation: Map apps use AI to continuously update routes based on real‑time traffic information, helping you avoid jams.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is an example of predictive text on a smartphone?
options: The phone suggesting the next word while you type
mcqs.explanation: Predictive text refers to the AI feature that suggests the next word as you type, as described in the smartphone section.

mcqs.question: In the banking example, what triggers the AI to send an alert to the user?
options: A purchase in a different city
A purchase at the same store
mcqs.explanation: The lesson states that the bank’s AI detects unusual activity, such as a purchase in a different city, and sends an instant alert.
